profile.headline: Software Developer

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description: Selected from over 400 applicants to enroll in a high-intensity coding school focused on Object Oriented Programming. Applying Agile and Scrum methodologies to project-based learning through the completion of  over 800 hours of hands-on software development experience with a strong emphasis on writing clean code and embracing Test Driven Development.  Spending 80+ hours per week working on individual and team-based projects to build proficiency with core Java in addition to other languages and frameworks such as SQL, Spring, Ionic, Angular, and JavaScript/TypeScript.

positions.title: Substitute Teacher - English as a Second Language
positions.description: Taught ESL classes of college-aged and older students in an average class size of 15 on an as-needed substitute basis.  Executed given lesson plans in accordance with ELS program standards, evaluated and assessed students when required, and provided extra help and tutoring to students when asked.

positions.title: Section Leader
positions.description: Monitored inventory levels and ordered product to meet Just In Time delivery requirements for the shelf-stable non-dairy beverage section.  Organized this section to maximize customer appeal and comply with bi-monthly "Fearless Flyer" promotions. Provided a "WOW!" customer experience on a daily basis.  Kept pace with product restocking and section maintenance in a high-volume store.  Helped create a fun and engaging retail environment while retaining professionalism and level-headedness during peak hours.

positions.title: Freelance Contributor
positions.description: Writes online articles pertaining to the stock market on a freelance basis under the name E.W. Barnaba.  Crafts insightful investment theses and delivers a supporting argument in articles.  Maintains a per-article readership level above site average.

positions.title: Bartender
positions.description: Provided friendly, fast, and knowledgable service in a high-volume bar environment.  Mixed house and classic cocktails swiftly and accurately.  Maintained bar inventory records and followed all ABC regulations regarding proper alcohol handling.

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description: Offered individualized tutoring in literature, grammar, and writing to local high school and college students.  Developed strong, long-lasting client relationships.

positions.title: Teacher - English / Technology Education
positions.description: Taught Advanced & General sections of English 11 & 12.  Wrote lesson plans in accordance with Virginia SOLs to help student learn the language arts skills required for future success.  Created problem solving and resource management exercises for technology education students.

publications.title: 2 Grocers That Will Survive The Amazon/Whole Foods Merger
